title: Subagent and background requests use a separate prompt-cache TTL

fix.text: Requests outside the main conversation keep the five-minute default until you choose a TTL for them. A one-hour TTL keeps their cache warm across longer pauses, but the API bills one-hour cache writes at a higher rate, so only set subagentPromptCacheTtl if your subagents regularly pause for more than five minutes.
